title: 第15章 被欺负的李正通第16章 灵根升级了
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
秦宇轻松翻过院墙，快步跑到李正通身旁。
“怎么回事？你这是被谁打了？”
李正通上气不接下气的说道：“宇哥...那天我用了你教的方法...”
秦宇眼睛一瞪：“是那两个检查的说你不合格，把你给打成这样？”
“不...不是！”
李正通抹了一把眼泪，继续说道：“那两个检查人员说我干的不错，只要不让枫叶在地上堆积的太厚就好，不用一直干。”
“当时我还很开心，想着以后还可以白天偷懒修炼一会儿。”
“但没想到第二天，就有一大群人骑着灵兽从那路过，那些灵兽边走边拉，我不但要收拾落叶，还要收拾粪便，每天都要打扫到很晚才能打扫完。”
“御兽峰那群灵兽跑你那去了？”
秦宇没想到自己间接把李正通给坑了。
明明那么多条路可以选择，他们偏偏选择枫叶广场，只能说李正通太倒霉了！
“宇哥你怎么知道他们是御兽峰的？”
李正通并没有察觉到秦宇语气的变化。
秦宇有些心虚的看了看天上的星星，岔开话题反问道：“那你身上的伤是怎么回事？”
问到这，李正通就更委屈了。
“活太多，我实在干不完，今天我就鼓足勇气挡在那些御兽峰灵兽前，求让他们换条路走。”
“谁知那个为首之人直接跳下来，二话不说就打了我一巴掌，让我滚一边去！”
说话间，秦宇上下打量李正通，发现这小子似乎比十天前更壮实一点。
正常锻炼十天，不可能有这么明显的效果。
‘难道这就是千锤百炼天赋反馈的效果？’

‘每打扫完一次卫生，就能增强一点力量？’
了解了事情的前因后果，秦宇安慰道：“你先去清洗一下，我来给你想想办法。”
“宇哥，你可千万别去找御兽峰那些人。”
“他们都是入宗多年的外门弟子，咱们打不过他们，也惹不起他们。”
秦宇点点头，“放心，我还没蠢到去与他们比武力，你赶紧去换身衣服，身上都臭死了。”
“好的宇哥！”
李正通擦了擦眼泪，走进了屋子。
秦宇坐在院子里的石凳上，有些犹豫不决。
到底要不要帮李正通？
现在李正通正在经历磨难，而‘千锤百炼’天赋也确实在实打实的帮助李正通提升。
所以秦宇不知道现在插手，帮助李正通解决困难，对李正通来说是好是坏。
听着屋里还时不时传出的抽泣声，秦宇猛地一拍大腿。
‘我特么真该死啊，就是因为我，好兄弟才被欺负成这个样子，现在我竟然还在犹豫要不要插手。
秦宇恨不得抽自己两巴掌。
看李正通哭成这样，无法想象这十天里他有多委屈。
一个十四五岁的少年，离开父母朋友，承载着全家的希望，孤身一人来到玄天宗。
本以为来到天堂，却没想到自己只是个清洁工，吃着没啥滋味的辟谷丹，干着又脏又累的苦力活，还要时不时被检查卫生的人训，被御兽峰的弟子欺负。
content_en:
Qin Yu easily climbed over the courtyard wall and quickly ran to Li Zhengtong's side.
"What's going on? Who were you beaten by?"
Li Zhengtong said breathlessly: "Brother Yu...I used the method you taught me that day..."
Qin Yu's eyes widened: "Did those two inspectors say you were unqualified and beat you like this?"
"No...no!"
Li Zhengtong wiped away his tears and continued: "The two inspectors said that I did a good job, as long as I didn't let the maple leaves pile up too thick on the ground, I didn't have to keep doing it."
"I was very happy at the time, thinking that I could be lazy and practice for a while during the day."
"But I didn't expect that the next day, a large group of people would pass by on spirit beasts. Those spirit beasts would pull them as they walked. Not only did I have to clean up the fallen leaves, but I also had to clean up the feces. I had to clean it until very late every day."
"Did the group of spirit beasts from Yushou Peak run away to you?"
Qin Yu didn't expect that he had indirectly tricked Li Zhengtong.
There were so many paths to choose from, but they chose Maple Leaf Plaza. It can only be said that Li Zhengtong was so unlucky!
"Brother Yu, how do you know they are from Beast Control Peak?"
Li Zhengtong did not notice the change in Qin Yu's tone.
Qin Yu looked at the stars in the sky with some guilt, changed the subject and asked, "Then what's the matter with your injuries?"
When asked about this, Li Zhengtong felt even more aggrieved.
"There is too much work and I really can't finish it. Today I mustered up the courage to stand in front of those beast-controlling peak spirit beasts and beg them to change their way."
"Unexpectedly, the leader jumped down and slapped me without saying a word, telling me to get out of the way!"
While talking, Qin Yu looked Li Zhengtong up and down and found that the boy seemed to be stronger than ten days ago.
It is impossible to have such obvious effects after ten days of normal exercise.
‘Could this be the effect of feedback from a talent that has been tempered over and over again? ’
‘Every time you clean the house, can you gain a little strength? ’
After understanding the cause and effect of the matter, Qin Yu comforted: "Go and clean it first, and I will think of a solution for you."
"Brother Yu, you must not go to those people at Yushou Peak."
"They are all outer disciples who have been in the sect for many years. We can't defeat them, nor can we offend them."
Qin Yu nodded, "Don't worry, I'm not stupid enough to compete with them. You should quickly change your clothes. You're all smelly."
"Okay Brother Yu!"
Li Zhengtong wiped his tears and walked into the room.
Qin Yu sat on the stone bench in the yard, hesitant.
Do you want to help Li Zhengtong?
Now Li Zhengtong is going through hardships, and the talent of "thousands of tempers" is really helping Li Zhengtong improve.
So Qin Yu didn't know whether it would be good or bad for Li Zhengtong to intervene now and help Li Zhengtong solve his difficulties.
Listening to the sobbing that could be heard from time to time in the room, Qin Yu slapped his thigh suddenly.
‘I really deserve to die. It’s because of me that my good brother was bullied like this, and now I’m still hesitant to intervene.
Qin Yu wished he could slap himself twice.
Seeing Li Zhengtong crying like this, I can't imagine how wronged he was during these ten days.
A boy of fourteen or fifteen years old, left his parents and friends, carried the hope of his whole family, and came to Xuantian Sect alone.
I thought I was in heaven, but I didn't expect that I was just a cleaner, eating tasteless Bigu Pills, doing dirty and tiring hard work, being scolded by hygiene inspectors from time to time, and being bullied by the disciples of Yushou Peak.
